query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(d.birth_date) AS birth_year,
    COUNT(*) AS employee_count
FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j
JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON j.id = d.id
WHERE j.is_active_job = 1 
AND j.employer_name = 'شركة أوبن لتقنية المعلومات'
AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY YEAR(d.birth_date)
ORDER BY birth_year;
